items.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary_en: OpenAI describes a payment feature that lets agents complete purchases without seeing users' card details, with a security check on each purchase. It is to launch first through dots for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US.
items.notes: Direct fetch of openai.com failed (domain not in session's allowed network). Content and date come from a web-search result summary of the official page, not a direct read. Verify before publication.

items.title: OpenAI backs child-safety research and signs a children's AI charter
items.summary_en: OpenAI signed the Charter of Engagement for Safer AI for Children. It also committed $2 million to a scientific research network on AI and children's safety.

items.title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT beta
items.summary_en: A beta lets businesses manage their information and reach users in ChatGPT. It adds Business Agents, starting with eligible ecommerce and online service businesses in the US.

items.title: OpenAI publishes community compact and compute campus policy blueprint
items.summary_en: OpenAI published a National Community Compact and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint. They cover community input and developer accountability for future data center campuses.

items.title: OpenAI introduces Images 2.6
items.summary_en: The update brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing, and new API controls. It covers ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

coverage_note: New official OpenAI posts were found for 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-13.
